description: Search Google and get current results with links, snippets and dates — web, news, images, videos, places, shopping or Google Scholar. COSTS USD 0.005 per call, paid automatically in USDC from the configured wallet. Use it when the answer depends on information that is current, local, or outside what you already know.

country.description: Two-letter market, e.g. us, it, de

freshness.description: Only results from the last day/week/month/year

language.description: Two-letter result language, e.g. en, it

location.description: City-level location, e.g. "Milan, Italy" — useful with type=places

num.description: How many results, up to 10. Default 10

page.description: Which page of results. Each page is a separate paid call

name: serp402_search
